topic: The parity conjecture in OEIS A323206, COMMENTS, revision 52
title: OEIS A323206, COMMENTS (revision 52): Proof of Luschny's parity conjecture and binary consequences

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Peter Luschny's conjecture in OEIS A323206, COMMENTS, revision 52 (first posed in revision 17, February 21, 2019): for all nonnegative n,k, the terminating hypergeometric value A(n,k) is odd precisely when n is even or k+2 is a positive power of two. Its coefficients are integer ballot numbers, and their sum is C_(k+1). Thus evaluation modulo two reduces to the constant coefficient or a Catalan number. A binary product describes the complete coefficient support; its consequences include the linked rows, columns, three adjacent diagonals, antidiagonal sums and generalized ballot triangle.
summary: A complete proof of the A323206 parity criterion, with a binary coefficient product, support count and degree, integer-argument extensions, formal generating identities and parity consequences for the linked generalized Catalan and ballot sequences.
